SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF NOV-15-2017 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF NOV-15-2017 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. PLAINTIFFF ANTON GROSZ IS PRESENT. DEFENDANTS FRED MORSE AND THE MORSE FAMILY TRUST ARE PRESENT, RESPRESENTED BY DENNIS DOYLE. BOTH PROOF OF SERVICE ARE UNTIMELY. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL; CLERK: J. MURPHY; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-15-2017 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GROSZ, ANTON IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT MORSE, FRED MORSE FAMILY TRUST THE EVIDENCE PRESENTED DID NOT SUPPORT PLAINTIFF'S CLAIMS BY A PREPONDERANCE OF THE EVIDENCE THAT AN ACT OR OMISSION BY THE DEFENDANT WAS A CAUSE OF DAMAGE, LOSS OR HARM TO THE PLAINTIFF. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
